stories.title: Sources: Simmons told to leave Chiefs team meeting by Reid, Mahomes
stories.summary: Josh Simmons was kicked out of a team meeting by Chiefs coach Andy Reid and QB Patrick Mahomes, but the OT later apologized, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: Sources: Colts face big decisions on star players as trade deadline looms
stories.summary: The Colts are expected to field trade inquiries on some of their star players, including Jonathan Taylor, DeForest Buckner and Quenton Nelson.

stories.title: Brewers 'chip away' at Rays again, rally to take 2-0 lead in World Series
stories.summary: The Brewers rallied from a 4-0 deficit in the first inning to beat the Rays 5-4 in Game 2 on Saturday and take a 2-0 lead in the World Series.

stories.title: 76ers' Brown claims no beef, but says Tatum has 'hell of a PR team'
stories.summary: In the latest turn in the relationship between former teammates, Jaylen Brown said Jayson Tatum should "stay ready at all times" while denying the two have beef.

stories.title: Rams optimistic that star WR Nacua will play vs. Raiders, source says
stories.summary: The Rams are optimistic that star wide receiver Puka Nacua will play Sunday against the Raiders, a source told ESPN.
